facts.fact: Jade（Petra 的挚友、后被证实是伪装）骗 Petra：藏宝图瓶里另夹着一张通往第六层捷径的便条
facts.anchor: It also had a note about a shortcut to the Sixth in this area.

facts.fact: Petra 查自己的追踪器：已在 Void 里待了 121 小时，一天内抵达第六层仍来得及返地面
facts.anchor: I’ve been in the Void for 121 hours

facts.fact: Jade 用一块沾血的石头砸中 Petra 的头部，把她打倒在地
facts.anchor: Jade standing over me, clutching a bloodied rock

facts.fact: Jade 割开自己的手臂取血，把血泼在 Petra 周围围成环，又用石头摆出同心圆做献祭阵
facts.anchor: She pours the blood in a ring around me.

facts.fact: Jade 承认本打算找机会杀掉客户 Henry（雇她俩找 glow gem 的活儿），以启动自己的献祭计划
facts.anchor: I was planning to find a way to get him killed

facts.fact: Jade 讲出女神条款：每六年献祭一人，女神就赐献祭者一具可在地面生活的人类身体
facts.anchor: every six years, if we bring a sacrifice to her

facts.fact: Petra 用仅剩的那条手臂的力气把刀刺进 Jade 的颈部，杀死了她
facts.anchor: I stab her with all the strength my one arm can muster.

facts.fact: Flint（雇主 Mr. Stone 的学徒）用石头砸碎 Jade 的头骨，取脑组织样本带回地面给 Mr. Stone 研究
facts.anchor: Flint bashes the rock into Jade’s skull with a sickening thwack.
